plate_comment: Confirms each converter clutch engagement. The rising edge of the converter clutch solenoid request (logical output 18) sets bit 0 of converter_clutch_transition_state (engagement pending), and converter_clutch_engagement_timer counts down from converter_clutch_engagement_time_limit (3 s). While the request is on and transmission_speed_ratio is inside the gear's locked window (transmission_2nd / 3rd / 4th_gear_locked_speed_ratio_minimum / _maximum, around the gear ratios: no converter slip), bits 0 and 2 clear: the engagement is confirmed. In 1st they clear too. If the timer runs out first, it sets the lockup inhibit (condition_eval bit 6) and bit 2 (engagement timed out), and bit 2 clears again when the inhibit clears (was cm848_processProtectionRateLimitFlags)

The 48RE high gear governor pressure mode (pressure state 0x10): in 3rd / 4th outside transfer-case low range, with the lever not in 1 / 2 (transmission_selected_gear 0x7e / 0x7f), lockup not inhibited (condition_eval bit 6), transmission_overheat_protection_active_flag clear and switch 12 off, while the throttle is below the output-speed curve (or the second curve once in the mode, held by load_condition_flags bit 2), the target is governor_pressure_high_gear_target. With the lever in 1 / 2 and the output speed below protection_derate_ramp_exit_threshold_cal it requests the 4-3 downshift (condition_eval bit 1, clearing the 3-4 bit 2) unless overdrive_control_flags bit 3 is set (was cm848_calculateProtectionThresholdLimit)
